_comment: Registry of MCP servers reachable through scripts/mcp.sh.
pi has no MCP support and this stack does not want it: a single MCP server can
publish hundreds of tool schemas into a 64K window before the first message.
mcp2cli turns those servers into a CLI instead, so a schema only enters the
context when the model asks for that one tool.
Each entry needs exactly one of:
stdio  a command mcp2cli spawns and speaks MCP to over stdio
transport    auto | sse | streamable   (url entries only; default auto)
auth_header  Name:Value — supports env:VAR and file:/path for the value,
so no credential has to be written into this committed file
env          {"KEY": "VALUE"} passed to a stdio server's environment

everything.description: MCP reference server (13 demo tools). Verifies the plumbing without touching anything real.
